reported: after the captain dispatched the first batch, the scheduler never woke the next members; the team froze
verdict: root-caused on the live machine, fixed, regression-locked (failing-first), gates green

rootCause.what: lib/members.js#deliverToMember called ctx.subagents.followup(parent, childId, content, options)
rootCause.why: the running Harness (dsh 0.1.2-rc.1) exposes no `followup` member on the subagent service; delivery is the host-only FIFO queue runtime[Symbol.for('dsh.subagent.queuePrompt')](parent, childId, content, source, signal). Alpha.2 owned followup/registerContinuableSetup; Alpha.5/rc.1 replaced both.
rootCause.consequence: the call threw TypeError inside deliverToMember's catch -> false -> the claim rolled back to `pending` and the member stayed idle, so no member was ever woken. The first batch appeared to start only because the spawn prompt lists each member's assigned task count, so Planner/Researcher claimed t1/t2 themselves.
